The Verses of the Elder Gaṅgātīriya:
“On the bank of the Ganges, my hut was built from three palm leaves;”
A sixty-year-old almsbowl and a robe made of discarded rags—
these are my two possessions during these two years of the rains-retreat.
A single word was spoken by me;
in the third year of the rains-retreat,
the mass of darkness was shattered.
